summary: MoonStar is a web based adventure, where you as an astronaut will decide where to land on the moon, the objectives and different advantages for your adventure, make your operations base and experience being the leader on a new outpost on the moon. With limited resources, different stations to manage and different problems that will occur, you are challenged to properly administer the outpost and teach you about the compromise that astronauts will face once this outpost becomes a reality. Is easy to image life in another planet, we idealize it as being on earth but with a different sky or seeing moon, when in truth things are vastly different more when it comes to the first colonize efforts that humanity will make, this game gives people a way to really see how life would be until full environmental transformation of a planet can be achieved, and the difficult decision that will be made.
details:
The project consists of a game where you are the administrator of an outpost on the moon, giving the user several choices that range from choosing the landing zone to selecting specializations, each having a different array of conditions to diversify the challenges that astronauts may face on the moon. This creates a safe environment to experiment with the equipment needed for survival in those conditions, where one can see how it would work, what would be needed, and the different types of dangers an outpost, if not a colony, would face. This means that failure is an opportunity for learning rather than a life-or-death situation.

Made using React for the UI and user interfaces, TypeScript for the programming and logic of the web application, Three.js to build the visuals of the environment, Vite for the suite of tools, and Node.js and Express for data consultation and server functions, alongside different APIs from NASA itself.

The purpose is to create a fun, visually appealing game where one can play through a run and administer the outpost, facing difficulties and experiencing the decision-making necessary to overcome them. It also offers educational information for curious minds, helping to feed the hunger for knowledge that many have.

Every module in MoonStar features its own interactive mini-game, turning lunar base management into an engaging hands-on experience.

From solving engineering challenges to exploring scientific discoveries, players must think critically, react to unexpected situations, and make decisions to keep their outpost running.

These short, engaging activities help players develop problem-solving skills, logical thinking, observation, and resource management while learning about real concepts behind space exploration.

Learning is no longer just about reading or watching. In MoonStar, players learn by doing, experimenting, and discovering.
